problem.title: Shortest and Lexicographically Smallest Beautiful String

approaches.title: Sliding window over substrings containing k ones
approaches.summary: Uses a sliding window to enumerate candidate substrings containing exactly k ones, trimming leading zeroes and retaining the shortest, lexicographically smallest candidate.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented the sliding-window solution with null-based tracking for the best candidate and explicit empty-string fallback.
Refactored the same sliding-window strategy to use an empty string sentinel and more idiomatic increment and decrement operators.
